author: Georgi, 1775
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수천 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록
summary: 비교적 흔한 겨울철새로, 강과 하구, 저수지, 해안에서 작은 무리를 지어 지낸다. 볍씨와 곡물 같은 여러 씨앗과 물풀을 즐겨 먹고 물속 곤충도 먹으며, 해 질 무렵에는 농경지로 날아들어 먹이를 찾는다. 시베리아 동부, 사할린, 캄차카반도, 홋카이도에서 번식하고 한국, 일본, 중국 남부에서 겨울을 난다. 국내에서는 전국의 강과 하천 같은 비교적 큰 습지에서 보이며, 특히 낙동강과 영산강 등 남부에서 많이 월동한다.

sexes.male: 머리에 녹색 광택의 긴 댕기가 있고, 흰 멱과 검은 목테, 이마의 흰 점, 검은 띠가 둘린 노란 엉덩이가 눈에 띈다. 가슴은 비늘무늬처럼 보이고, 둥글고 길게 늘어진 셋째날개깃이 꼬리를 가린다.
sexes.female: 전체가 고른 갈색에 흑갈색 무늬가 있고 부리는 검다.

art.subject: Falcated Duck (Mareca falcata), adult male in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean rivers from November to March: crown dark chestnut-bronze; sides of the head and a long, full mane of nape feathers glossy bottle-green; a small white spot on the forehead just above the bill; white chin and throat bordered below by a narrow black collar; breast grey with dense black crescent fringes giving a scaly look; flanks pale grey finely vermiculated; long, drooping, sickle-shaped black-and-grey tertials curving down over the tail; a creamy-yellow triangle on each side of the rear, bordered with black; undertail black. Black bill; dark eye; dark grey legs.
art.pose: swimming in a small flock, side view
art.scene: Korean winter: a broad river with farmland beyond the bank; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view swimming: chestnut crown, long glossy green mane, small white forehead spot, white throat with a black collar, scaly grey breast, long drooping sickle tertials over the tail, black-bordered creamy-yellow rear patch, black bill
adult female, side view swimming: uniform brown with dark brown markings, plain greyish-brown head with a short mane, black bill
art.build: Medium-sized dabbling duck, about 48cm, a little smaller than a Mallard, with a large-looking maned head and a short neck. Bill black, slim, about as long as the head. Legs dark grey. The male's long, curved tertials hang down like sickles over the tail and rear flanks. Swims and up-ends in small flocks. In flight the male shows a pale grey forewing and a dark green speculum.
avoid: Do not paint a rufous head with a cream forehead stripe; that is Eurasian Wigeon (Mareca penelope).
Do not put a white neck ring on a green head with a yellow bill; that is Mallard (Anas platyrhynchos).
Do not paint the tertials short or straight; they are long, curved and drooping over the tail.
Do not paint a chestnut breast; the breast is grey and scaly.
